Corollary
[volume-pinching precompactness]

Source: petersen:page-0444, petersen:page-0445 ↗ lem:pet-ch11-anderson-volume-pinching-euclidean ↗ thm:pet-ch11-fundamental-theorem-convergence 1. ch11:11.4.6Given $n\ge 2$, $-\infty <\lambda \le \Lambda <\infty $, and $D,R>0$, choose $\delta =\delta (n,\lambda R^2)$ so that the class of closed Riemannian $n$-manifolds with $(n-1)\Lambda \ge \Ric \ge (n-1)\lambda $, $\diam \le D$, $\vol B(p,R)\ge (1-\delta )v(n,\lambda ,R)$ is precompact in the $C^{1,\alpha }$ topology for every $\alpha \in (0,1)$, and in particular contains only finitely many diffeomorphism types.
Proof

↗ cor:pet-ch11-volume-pinching-precompactness \sketch Use the blow-up normalization from subsection 4.1. Under $\bar g_i=k_i^2g_i$, relative volume comparison gives, for fixed $r$,

\[ \vol _{\bar g_i}B(p_i,r)\ge (1-\delta )v(n,\lambda k_i^{-2},r) \longrightarrow (1-\delta )\omega _nr^n . \]

The compactness theorem subsection 3.5 produces a Ricci-flat limit, which is Euclidean by subsection 4.2. This contradicts the normalized nonzero harmonic norm and proves the required uniform control.

□
